pluginConfigFields.label: Network analyzer addresses
pluginConfigFields.help: Comma-separated addresses or names of Harogic network analyzers to look for, e.g. `192.168.1.100, harogic-net1.local`. Add `:port` if the data port is not 5000. A name also reaches an analyzer on another subnet over IPv6, on the same cable or switch. USB analyzers are found automatically.

pluginConfigFields.label: Find network analyzers automatically
pluginConfigFields.help: Lists every Harogic network analyzer announcing itself (mDNS) on this computer's networks, including one on another subnet reachable over IPv6.

deviceConfigFields.label: Address or name (network analyzers)
deviceConfigFields.help: IPv4 address or name of a Harogic network analyzer, e.g. `192.168.1.100` or `harogic-net1.local`. A name also reaches it on another subnet over IPv6 link-local. Leave empty for a USB analyzer.
